articles.text: 教師: この道をまっすぐ行って、外堀通りを左に曲がると、三つ目の信号の右の角です。 (Kyoushi: Kono michi o massugu itte, Sotobori Dori o hidari ni magaru to, mittsu-me no shingoo no migi no kado desu.)
INSTRUCTOR: Go straight down this street, turn left on Sotobori Avenue, and it's at the right corner of the third traffic light.
学生: 東急ホテルですね。 (Gakusei: Tokyu Hoteru desu ne?)
STUDENT: That's the Tokyu Hotel, right?

教師: この道をまっすぐ行って、外堀通りを左に曲かります。そこからまっすぐ行くと右の方にあります。東急ホテルの手前です。 (Kyoushi: Kono michi o massugu itte, Sotobori Dori o hidari ni magarimasu. Soko kara massugu iku to migi no hoo ni arimasu. Tokyu Hoteru no temae desu.)
INSTRUCTOR: Go straight down this street and turn left on Sotobori Avenue. From there, go straight and it's on the right. It's just before the Tokyu Hotel.
学生: オークラホテルですね。 (Gakusei: Okura Hoteru desu ne?)
STUDENT: That's the Okura Hotel, right?
教師: この道をまっすぐ行って、三つ目の信号のむこうの右にあります。 (Kyoushi: Kono michi o massugu itte, mittsu-me no shingoo no mukoo no migi ni arimasu.)
INSTRUCTOR: Go straight down this street, and it's on the right beyond the third traffic light.
学生: 日枝神社ですね。 (Gakusei: Hie Jinja desu ne?)
STUDENT: That's Hie Shrine, right?
教師: この道をまっすぐ行って、二つ目の交差点を左に曲がります。国会議事堂の前をまっすぐ行くと右の方です。 (Kyoushi: Kono michi o massugu itte, futatsu-me no koosaten o hidari ni magarimasu. Kokkai Gijidoo no mae o massugu iku to migi no hoo desu.)
INSTRUCTOR: Go straight down this street and turn left at the second intersection. Go straight in front of the Diet Building, and it's on the right.
学生: 外務省ですね。 (Gakusei: Gaimushoo desu ne?)
STUDENT: That's the Foreign Ministry, right?

教師: 大使館を出て外堀通りまで行って、左に曲がります。二つ目の角を又左に曲がって、ずっとまっすぐ行くと、右に大きなタワーが見えます。 (Kyoushi: Taishikan o dete Sotobori Dori made itte, hidari ni magarimasu. Futatsu-me no kado o mata hidari ni magatte, zutto massugu iku to, migi ni ookina tawaa ga miemasu.)
INSTRUCTOR: Exit the Embassy and go to Sotobori Avenue, then turn left. Turn left again at the second corner, go straight ahead, and you'll see a big tower on the right.
学生: 赤坂プリンスホテルですね。 (Gakusei: Akasaka Purinsu Hoteru desu ne?)
STUDENT: That's the Akasaka Prince Hotel, right?
